problem.title: Count Collisions on a Road
problem.problemStatement: There are n cars on a road. Each car is initially moving: Left ('L') Right ('R') Stationary ('S') Whenever moving cars collide: Two moving cars become stationary. A moving car colliding with a stationary car also becomes stationary. Determine the total number of collisions that occur after all movements have finished.
problem.input: A string of length n consisting only of 'L', 'R', and 'S'.
problem.output: A single integer representing the total number of collisions.
